basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and anime enthusiast based in Seattle, WA. I spend most of my evenings diving into metroidvania games and catching up on the latest Attack on Titan episodes. When I'm not gaming, I'm jamming along with Davie504 videos or exploring new music genres. Working as a software developer for a tech start-up, I enjoy the flexibility of remote work. Currently single and enjoying the freedom of having my own space. I'm usually online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: A self-taught gaming aficionado with a deep passion for metroidvania-style games. My expertise stems from years of playing, reviewing, and discussing games on forums. Additionally, I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which feeds my interest in game development and technology.
